original_test_intent: Verify every expected physical GPU appears in NVSM with the correct UUID, model, slot/BDF, firmware/link/MIG properties and health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load GPU UUID/serial/model/slot/BDF/firmware/link/MIG-mode manifest; run exact `nvsm show gpus` read-only; retain raw hierarchy/status/health; compare complete physical-device set and properties, accounting for approved hidden/MIG/virtualized scope, without changing GPU state.
manual_activity: GPU/platform owner supplies expected physical/MIG scope and property manifest and dispositions every missing, mismatched or non-OK GPU.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, reset GPUs, toggle MIG or change clocks/power
Resolve by UUID/serial, not index order
engineer_actions: Approve GPU/MIG scope and property rules

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a UUID-keyed expected/observed table including model, physical location, firmware/link, MIG mode and health.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target GPU information and health; missing manifest is a project input and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and GPU manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Uses stable physical identity and separates GPU/MIG visibility so index order or logical instances cannot hide missing hardware.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU indices are driver-order artifacts and MIG changes logical visibility without changing physical population. UUID/serial/slot correlation is required to prove the intended physical devices and their NVSM health are present.
